镜头 s28：纪录片现场纪实镜头，时长 10 秒，16:9 横屏，24fps，单镜头一镜到底（只写 [Shot 1]）。
年代与画面风格（detailed_description 第一行照此英文书写）：raw verite documentary footage shot handheld in 2075 on a high-ISO full-frame documentary camera in available light only: visible sensor noise, deep solid blacks, volumetric haze and silhouettes, true-to-life skin tones, focus occasionally hunting
该类型的纪录片默认机位：fly-on-the-wall documentary camera, shoulder-mounted handheld with small reframings, operator reacting late
导演意图（自然语言）：手持中景，镜头缓缓推近两双手。修理铺的台灯下，波爷把那只带天线的旧铁盒放进阿牧手里，按了按他的手背，低声说了一句。环境声：电烙铁的滋滋声、远处的街声。
情绪：solemn, intimate, conspiratorial
建议的景别与运镜（只做一个主要运镜）：medium shot, handheld with one slow push in toward their hands
景深与虚实：Hands and the box sharp, faces slightly soft, the stall clutter blurred.
输入图片（按发送顺序；Subject N 对应 Picture N）：
Picture 1: the storyboard keyframe of this shot (opening frame). It shows: Handheld documentary medium shot in Boye's cramped repair stall under a warm desk lamp in 2075: Boye, 61, presses the old dented tin box with its antenna (plain lid, no sticker yet) into the hands of Amu, a 34-year-old engineer in an orange-grey insulated coverall, and covers Amu's hands with his own. Blocking lock: Boye at frame left, Amu at frame right, the tin box between their hands at frame centre under the desk lamp; shelves of old electronics in the background.
Picture 2: Amu (34, male communications engineer, the protagonist) (character reference; role: the protagonist). A 34-year-old Chinese man, communications maintenance engineer for a planetary engine. Short messy black hair, a thin old scar through his left eyebrow, light stubble, lean face, tired intelligent eyes. Worn orange-and-grey insulated work coverall with scuffed reflective strips, a small canvas tool pouch strapped across his chest, fingerless thermal gloves.
Picture 3: Song's prototype node (the dented tin box, still without a sticker) (prop reference; role: prop reference). A handmade prototype network node: an old dented steel tin box with a plain scratched olive-grey lid, a salvaged circuit board, a small heat sink, three tiny LEDs and a short screw-on antenna, on a cluttered lab workbench under a desk lamp. No sticker on the lid.
Picture 4: Boye's electronics repair stall (location reference; role: location reference). Interior of a tiny electronics repair stall in an alley of an underground city: shelves overflowing with old routers, CRT monitors, radio parts, coils of wire, a soldering station under a single warm desk lamp, a kettle, a faded photograph pinned to the wall, a roll-up steel shutter half open. Empty of people.
台词（逐字照抄，按顺序，每句放进一个 <d>[Chinese] ...</d>）：
1. Boye (old male voice, slow and slightly hoarse) — 波爷（六十多岁老人的声音，缓慢、沙哑）: 别问它。让我们自己，认得彼此。
现场环境声：soldering iron sizzle, distant street noise, a kettle ticking
画面中没有字幕、文字、数字和水印；没有任何音乐和旁白；只说普通话。
